place.name: Whetstone Park and Columbus Park of Roses

features.name: Columbus Park of Roses
features.description: Columbus Park of Roses is the named 13-acre public garden within Whetstone Park, with five garden areas, more than 350 rose varieties and a separate dusk closing time.
